messages:
Elaine (eng-platform): heads up — noticed large dashboard (many heatmaps) got really slow after last canary, frameskips + long main-thread parse. attaching flame and HAR :eyes:
CJ: saw that too from EU canary, repro on prod canaries not on local. top was `chunk parse` and `telemetry-init`
Sahil: any chance the recent prefetch change bumped shared chunk size? we inlined a tiny helper into chart bundle earlier
Elaine (eng-platform): i grepped canary build logs — `shared-embedlib` jumped +120kb gz. suspect splitpoint moved. also kvcache miss rate spiking in heatmap routes
Ben: KV cache miss could explain repeated parse/rehydrate. routing policy changed last week to spread affinity across more hosts (to reduce hot shards) — maybe that increased cold cache prob
CJ: hmm yes we loosened `route_weight` sharding to 5 -> 12. that will increase cold-prefetchs. telemetry shows per-request cold_kv_hits up 3x for heavy dashboards
Aria (telemetry-bot): sample logs: 
```
route=heatmap id=ui-heatmap user=acct-42 cold_kv_miss=7 parse_ms=2100 chunk_parse_ms=800
route=metrics id=ui-metrics user=acct-7 cold_kv_miss=0 parse_ms=420 chunk_parse_ms=120
```
Elaine (eng-platform): so two vectors: chunk moved (bigger parse) + kvcache affinity fallout -> repeat parse. that's why LCP / frame drops
Sahil: short term: can we rollback the prefetch change and tighten route_weight? revert sharding to 5 and re-run canary?
CJ: we can, but that impacts thundering on hot hosts. alternative quick: increase kvcache TTL and prefetch window for heatmap route only to warm more aggressively
Ben: config patch prepared: 
```
routes.heatmap.prefetch_window: 4
kvcache.ttl.heatmap: 60s
```
Ben: deploy bot can push a patch to canary in ~10min
deploy-bot: deploying `hotfix/heatmap-prefetch` to canary (canary=eu,us)
Elaine (eng-platform): also propose a build tweak: move the chart renderer into an async boundary so parse cost deferred. small code-split: `chart/renderer` -> lazy import. that reduces immediate parse hit
Sahil: +1 for lazy import, but that's a release-change. need fallback for older bundles. can ship hotfix for runtime config first
CJ: agree. let's do config hotfix now, monitor telemetry for main-thread parse and cold_kv_miss. if not enough, rollback canary altogether
Aria (telemetry-bot): rolling metrics baseline in 2m. will alert if parse_ms > 800ms for 3m window
Elaine (eng-platform): thanks. Can someone attach the canary flame link here after deploy? I'll watch sessions and traces
Ben: flame: https://perf.redwood/trace/9a7b (canary) — initial canary shows parse_ms down ~40% for heatmap route after prefetch tweak :thumbsup:
CJ: seeing drop in cold_kv_miss too, good signal
Sahil: leaving note — follow-up PR: splitpoint map for embedlib to ensure minimal shared chunk growth. also add unit test to detect new splitpoint size > 50kb
Elaine (eng-platform): agreed. create issue and assign. also add a rollback playbook entry for routing weight changes (we didn't have one)
Ben: created issue #4129 "splitpoint regressions: embedlib chunk growth" and linked this thread
deploy-bot: canary patch finished. status=success
Elaine (eng-platform): nice work team. we'll keep canary for 30m and then decide. posting summary in #all-hands after we confirm
CJ: one more: can we add a lightweight telemetry tag that attributes slow LCP to either `chunk-parse` or `kv-cold` so future alerts can triage automatically?
Aria (telemetry-bot): created alert candidate `console.lcp.root_cause` with two buckets. will mock on next deploy and iterate
Elaine (eng-platform): perfect. thanks all :heart:
